title: Facial Vein Blood Collection in Mice
author: Ana Catarina Carapinha Cascalho

steps.title: Prepare animal and restraint
steps.instruction: If desired, anesthetize the mouse (optional); otherwise, properly restrain the animal with one hand to apply adequate pressure to the maxillary (submandibular) vein.

steps.title: Locate facial vein landmarks
steps.instruction: Identify the convenient landmark on albino mice (a small bald spot or hair whorl along the curvature of the mandible) or the equivalent spot on darker mice; the vein lies just below this mark in the groove past the jawbone. Align a lancet caudal to the angle of the mandible, extending toward the ear, and set the puncture site at the midway point of the lancet.

steps.title: Puncture vein with lancet
steps.instruction: Using the point of the lancet (Goldenrod; GR-4MM), apply firm pressure at the point caudal to the eye and ventral to the ear where the submandibular vein is located, then release until blood flows. Hold the needle or lancet perpendicular to the bleed site to avoid puncturing the ear canal.

steps.title: Collect blood into EDTA tube
steps.instruction: Quickly place the EDTA‑coated blood collection tube (Sarstedt; 20.1288) below the puncture site and allow blood to fill the tube to the desired volume. Immediately put the collected blood on ice.

steps.title: Stop bleeding and dispose lancet
steps.instruction: Apply gentle pressure with gauze until bleeding has stopped, then dispose of the needle/lancet into an approved sharps container.

steps.title: Separate plasma by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the blood sample at 2000 × g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes. The resulting supernatant is designated plasma.

steps.title: Transfer plasma to low‑binding tube
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the plasma into a clean polypropylene low‑protein‑binding tube using a micropipette.

steps.title: Maintain plasma temperature
steps.instruction: Keep the plasma samples at 2 °C – 8 °C while handling.

steps.title: Aliquot and store plasma if delayed
steps.instruction: If the plasma is not analysed immediately, aliquot it into 0.5 mL portions, store, and transport at –80 °C or lower.
